children: Most-active CBOT corn futures are off 1.6%, bringing the price down to roughly $4.66 a bushel. In a note, AgResource says that corn futures have now fallen below $4.70/a bushel--the level it pegged support at, opening the door for a further downturn. "The market feels bearish as the U.S. harvest pushes strongly ahead amid open weather," says AgResource--with more higher-than-expected yield figures enough to send futures lower. Soybeans fall 0.8% to around $12.51 a bushel, and wheat is down 0.9% to around $6.54 a bushel. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
